# Twisted23 Parlour & Spatial Games

> Twisted23 Parlour (https://www.twisted23.com) is an open, zero-ad STEM spatial reasoning and mathematics pavilion founded by Gary Francis Stout in partnership with Gravity Wizards, Inc. (Anchorage & Palmer, Alaska). Featuring authentic 24-state S4 3D-in-2D orthographic & Axle-Locked dice games, Botchee: Humpty Dumpty 2-Player Sudoku Egg Duels, rescued Flash puzzles from tophatpuzzle.com, Backgammon 36-Roll Lab, and Gravity Powered FOBB (Flying Object Built to Bounce) engineering labs.

## Playable Games & Spatial Parlour Labs
- [Twisted23 Parlour Lounge](https://www.twisted23.com/): 24-Tile Shape board, rescued Tophat Sudoku vault, and live 3D-in-2D orthographic rolling dice.
- [Botchee: Humpty Dumpty Egg Arena](https://www.twisted23.com/botchee/humpty/): Competitive 1v1 & vs-AI Sudoku duel with flying combo points (+5 row/column, +7 box, 3x X-diagonal organizer bonus), spoken animal turn timers, and dramatic winner ascension / loser Great Fall splat.
- [Flipping Dice 24-State 3D-in-2D](https://flippingdice.twisted23.com/): Tumble all 24 S4 cube orientations across a 2D grid (77-second Blitz & untimed Thinky modes) plus Axle-Locked `[1-6]`, `[2-5]`, and `[3-4]` 4-face rings.
- [Backgammon 36-Roll Lab](https://www.twisted23.com/backgammon/): Full-fidelity Backgammon with bilateral doubling cube, Gammon/Backgammon scoring, Axle-Locked dice variants, Pass & Play, and Night0WL Bot AI.
- [CameLcase Hangman](https://www.twisted23.com/hangman/): Cryptographic word puzzles utilizing CameLcase and Base-38 ident architecture.
- [z404 Lunar South Pole Moon Buggy](https://www.twisted23.com/z404/): Shackleton Rim moon buggy riding on Axle-Locked 4-pip wheel dice.
- [World Visitors Live Globe](https://www.twisted23.com/visitors/): Multi-realm live visitor globe across Twisted23, sLogbog (`https://slogbog.com`), and Gravity Wizards (`https://gravitywizards.com`).
- [User ControL PaneL (UCP)](https://www.twisted23.com/ucp/): Parlour member profiles, Base-38 call-signs, and leaderboards.

## Gravity Wizards Hardware, Emojis & Swift 6 3D Lab
- [Gravity Wizards Main Hub](https://gravitywizards.com/): FOBB STEM Flight Kits (`#761032c/b/p/g` Wizard's Basic Combo Kit, `#761082` Heavy Bone, `#761022` Bare Bone) & GPADA Gravity Powered Air Derbies in gymnasiums, high-ceiling hallways, and outdoors.
- [FOBB & 315MHz Key-Fob Emoji Vault](https://www.twisted23.com/fobb-emoji/): Official Spy 3D transparent FOBB & MSD RP11 wireless launcher key-fob custom emojis, Apple iCloud Sticker PNGs, and phpBB3 SLogBog `.pak` smilies.
- [SpatialStudio Swift 6 3D Graphics Starter](https://www.twisted23.com/swift-graphics/): Native macOS/iOS Metal + SceneKit PBR 3D Axle-Locked Dice & transparent bouncing FOBB Xcode 16 starter package.
- [SLogBog Ideas Forum](https://slogbog.com/): Companion phpBB3 discussion forum (`https://slogbog.com/app.php/feed` Atom feed).
- [Sitemap](https://www.twisted23.com/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap of all public routes.
